modes.label: Fight (melee)
modes.note: Steps are indexed by fight state 0-8; next state = transitions[state][rand4()]. State 7 (and 6 for enemies) is drawn as state 8.

modes.label: Shoot (bow)
modes.note: Aim (SHOOT1) is held while firing; release (SHOOT3) lasts one tick, then STILL.

modes.label: Dying / dead
modes.note: tactic starts at 7 (fmain.c:2773): first frame for tactic 7-5, second for 4-1, then DEAD (no weapon drawn, fmain.c:2400-2401).

modes.label: Frustrated (blocked)
modes.note: Hero blocked in every direction: the frame is held for frustflag 1-20 (dex = an->index, fmain.c:1477), then faces the player shaking his head (statelist 84/85 by (cycle >> 1) & 1) for 21-40, then shows statelist 40.

modes.label: Fall (pit)
modes.note: Frames come from the Loraii/necromancer ENEMY sheet, then the OBJECTS sheet.

notes.text: statelist 84-85 are the head-shake frames, reached through frustflag (see Frustrated)

with the bow, DYING draws OBJECTS frame 0 (an arrow): states 80-81 are not < 32, so the hand-weapon rule applies with k = 0 and statelist wpn_no 0. Kept as the source draws it; whether the bow was intended is unknown (reference/PROBLEMS.md P25)
